summary: Repaired pipeline.py convert_qkv to copy source row 3 * head + component into target row component * num_heads + head, yielding all Q heads, then all K heads, then all V heads. Added positive-integer head-count and rectangular nonempty-list layout validation, raising ValueError for invalid inputs. CPU NumPy float64 checks passed for 13 projection fixtures (maximum absolute error 0 with atol=rtol=0), 19 invalid layouts, input preservation, and independent output rows. The original same-shape implementation had maximum absolute projection error 52 on the fixed fixture. This evidence supports the tested row-conversion semantics only.
unverified: Validation covers synthetic CPU float64 projection fixtures only; no GPU or production-training validation was performed.
No complete model, gradients, optimizer update, task-quality, deployment runtime, or exact checkpoint-resume acceptance was tested.
Performance, throughput, training wall time, and memory were not measured.
